notes: v532 — four honesty fixes from a full audit of the reports, plus a new one. (1) The three-year verdicts are graded on a 5-DAY outcome window. If you switch the card to 10 or 30 days they now say so, are shown dimmed, and the 🏛 crown is withheld — because those marks answer a different question from the tier beside them. (2) Whether a flag 'fires today' now uses the SAME volume average as the grading engine (the last 90 trading days, not 90 calendar days) — previously the two definitions differed slightly, so today's firing list wasn't quite the event the engine had graded. (3) Volume averages now measure back from the DATA's own latest day instead of today's date — with stale or restored data the window used to shrink silently, and past ~90 days it switched volume flags off entirely. (4) The durability marks no longer disappear when you filter to gainers only or fallers only. NEW: each line now shows its TRAJECTORY across the three years — ↗ strengthening, → steady, ↘ fading or ∿ mixed, with the three edge numbers — so a SOLID line that is quietly decaying no longer looks identical to one that is growing. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
